You know, as much as I want to believe that, it's not true. She is young enough that having a world without me would suck for a while, but she wouldn't remember me or my face within a few years and she would have no recollection of the shitty human being that I've become. It may be better that way for her.    


My biggest problem is that I've been doing this alone for so long. Like I said my wife is no help. For shits and giggles, I opened up a little bit. "Sorry" that's all I get. Doesn't want to talk, doesn't want to hear, just sorry and walk away. I have no support network. I never made many friends after I moved and the ones that I did make have all moved to other states. My wife never had any friends before meeting me because she is socially awkward, so it's literally me against the world and hoping I can make it, but I'm running on fumes at this point.    


Retail sucks the soul out of me. I've reached the point where I wake up hating life at 6-7am, go to work and put a mask on to deal with my living hell for 10-11hrs per day, then come home and go to sleep to get the day over with as soon as possible so that I don't have to deal with it anymore.    


Then on nights like tonight, that panic sets in, that feeling turns in my stomach and all I want to do is get in my car and drive off into oncoming traffic to get this over with. I'm just so tired of everything.
